name: cc-enslaver
description: A Claude Code plugin and LLM-agnostic rule pack that enforces systematic thinking, verified citations, and root-cause analysis — eliminating reactive, lazy AI behavior. v0.24 is a health-audit release: a full architecture review plus multi-path adversarial model review (every finding re-verified with a runtime probe; red-first regression tests, 310 → 323) fixed 10 confirmed defects, 3 HIGH, zero new features. HIGH fixes: Windows state saves were silently lost to the plugin's OWN lock-free readers (os.replace vs an open reader → PermissionError → failing-open → the mutation vanished, with orphan .tmp debris as live evidence; read accessors now share the per-session lock, save() retries against non-cooperating external readers, load() retries transient OSError, gc sweeps day-old orphan tmp files); the layer-(i) sync acknowledgement was lost in the one-shot grace window (the primary block → 同步核对-recovery flow never persisted the ack, so an answered group re-blocked later — the grace path now reads the reply and acks); and a DENIED Write of a new file still registered its target as 'read', granting read-before-edit authorization for content the agent never saw. MED fixes: the rolling-patch counter's decide-and-record is now one atomic locked operation; rule 10 no longer flags Python forward-reference annotations (password: "SecretStr" — pure-alpha CamelCase values are type names, not secrets); rule 11 no longer flags URL routes (https://host/home/alice/… — a hostname-glued /home/ segment is a route; file:///home/… still denies); requirements*.txt / constraints*.txt are now scannable despite .txt (dependency manifests are a real credential-leak vector) while .asciidoc joins the prose exemption; and a stale rolling counter no longer survives delete-and-recreate. The three write branches of read_guard were deduplicated into one shared content-check pipeline, making the branch-drift bug class structurally impossible. Prior: v0.23 added rule 12 (repo-wide sync: per-project sync-gate.toml co-update groups enforced at Stop layer (i) with a marker escape, plus the repo-refresh whole-repo audit skill), a 160-char-per-item TL;DR cap at layer (h), and two HIGH production fixes (edit-gated Stop layers never fired — no turn_count in production payloads; session-state lost-update race); v0.22 added write-time content detectors rules 10 (no non-essential hardcoding) and 11 (no non-essential path dependency), PreToolUse-only with a why-comment escape hatch; v0.22.2 added the version-drift gate pinning every manifest version pointer, the README badge, and the newest CHANGELOG heading to plugin.json. English remains the i18n skeleton and source of truth (rules/ + prompts/ at the root, default injection); Chinese is a first-class translation (rules/zh/ + prompts/zh/, via CC_ENSLAVER_LANG=zh), with drift CI-blocked by i18n_check.py + test_i18n_sync.py.
